preliminary_statement: PRELIMINARY EVALUATION. 95 actual model responses were saved from the planned 216-request schedule. The primary comparison uses all 18 case/seed pairs (36 responses) for which both conditions completed. The other 59 unpaired responses remain in all-observed.csv and the raw evidence ZIP. The run stopped for the presentation deadline. Pair inclusion did not depend on correctness. The full 216-response study remains unfinished. Rates refer to this observed paired subset only.
